suiteTitle: PRAMITI Frontend Comprehensive End-to-End Automated Audit
subtitle: Regulatory Scrutiny, Document Provenance & Verification Evidence Engine

operations.title: Initial Scrutiny Gateway Load & Branding Audit
operations.description: Verify login page initial load, Ministry crest, PRAMITI title, rotating border animation, and live status ticker.

operations.title: Validation Error on Blank Credentials Submission
operations.description: Trigger form submission without Officer ID and verify alert banner prompts "Please enter both Officer ID and Passkey."

operations.title: Security Rejection on Invalid Passkey
operations.description: Submit invalid passkey and verify backend authentication failure handling with error toast.

operations.title: Login Gateway Theme Toggle (Dark to Light)
operations.description: Test theme toggle button on the login screen to switch from dark mode to light mode.

operations.title: Login Gateway Theme Toggle (Light back to Dark)
operations.description: Toggle theme back to dark mode for consistent scrutiny workstation ergonomics.

operations.title: Quick Department Profile Switching (Scrutiny Officer)
operations.description: Test the one-click "Scrutiny Officer" quick-fill credential profile button.

operations.title: Successful Authentication & JWT Token Acquisition
operations.description: Submit valid credentials, receive JWT Bearer token, verify localStorage persistence, and navigate to main application workspace.

operations.title: Executive Scrutiny Dashboard Overview
operations.description: Verify dashboard hero banner, active APH 2025-26 engine badge, topbar navigation, and sidebar navigation links.

operations.title: Audit Top KPI Metric Cards & Scrutiny Counters
operations.description: Audit the 4 statutory metric cards: Total Applications, Automatically Cleared, Needs Officer Review, and Critical Deficiencies.

operations.title: Application Pipeline Stages & Velocity Benchmark
operations.description: Verify 5-step APH Formal Workflow stage counters and Scrutiny Acceleration benchmark vs manual 120-minute baseline.

operations.title: Launch New Scrutiny Application Ingestion Modal
operations.description: Trigger the "New Application" button to open the application ingestion and showcase dossier registration modal.

operations.title: Select Benchmark Dossier B (Deficiencies Case)
operations.description: Select Dossier B (Discrepant Land, Lapsed Affiliation) to test deep regulatory scrutiny, AI clause citations, and ELA forensic detection.

operations.title: Dispatch End-to-End Evidence Scrutiny Pipeline
operations.description: Trigger "Ingest Application & Run Scrutiny", monitor live stepper (SHA-256 Digest, Native OCR, Issuing Authority Verification, Rule Engine), and await Scrutiny Workbench navigation.

operations.title: Scrutiny Workbench Redirection & Dossier Overview
operations.description: Verify automatic navigation to Application Detail View (/applications/:id) with institutional profile, Category badge, and Risk Index gauge.

operations.title: Statutory Document Checklist Verification
operations.description: Audit the 6 mandatory statutory document items (Affidavit, University NOC, Architectural Plan, NAAC, EoA Order, Faculty Profile).

operations.title: Visual Document Inspector & High-Resolution PDF Preview
operations.description: Audit the Visual Document Inspector panel showing the rendered PDF page, zoom controls, and extracted document metadata.

operations.title: Regulatory Findings & AICTE Clause Citations Tab
operations.description: Switch to the "Regulatory Findings" tab and audit detected non-compliances, severity badges (Critical / High), and handbook clause references.

operations.title: Cross-Document Conflict & Evidence Graph Tab
operations.description: Switch to the "Evidence Graph" tab and verify Cytoscape interactive graph rendering multi-entity document relationships and conflict edges.

operations.title: Evidence Graph Conflict Filter Toggle
operations.description: Toggle the Evidence Graph filter to "Conflicts Only" to isolate cross-document discrepancies.

operations.title: Regulatory Officer Decision Workbench (Open Modal)
operations.description: Open the "Issue Deficiency Notice" decision modal for formal administrative hearing and show-cause notice dispatch.

operations.title: Configure Hearing Window & Statutory Scrutiny Notes
operations.description: Select a 14-day hearing window and enter official scrutiny remarks referencing APH 2025-26 Section 4.2 and Section 2.3.

operations.title: Seal Statutory Determination with SHA-256 Cryptographic Sign
operations.description: Submit determination order, verify cryptographic signature recording, and confirm active Deficiency Notice banner on scrutiny workbench.

operations.title: Simulate Applicant Rectification Dossier Submission
operations.description: Trigger the "Simulate Applicant Rectification Dossier" action, which automatically updates defective documents with compliant counterparts and queues re-validation.

operations.title: Navigate to Regulatory Rule Store (/rules)
operations.description: Navigate via sidebar to Rule Compliance and audit the deterministic rule cards, clause citations, and severity tags.

operations.title: PageIndex Vectorless Handbook Explorer Tab
operations.description: Switch to the PageIndex Handbook Explorer tab and inspect the live status indicator and pre-indexed quick questions.

operations.title: PageIndex Quick Regulatory Question Query
operations.description: Click a pre-computed quick regulatory question ("Land requirements for Technical Campus in Mega/Metro Cities") and verify PageIndex query answer.

operations.title: Issuing Authority Verification Hub Audit (/verification)
operations.description: Navigate to Verification Hub and audit cross-authority verification events for SHCIL e-Stamp, State University NOC, CoA CAD Layout, and DigiLocker.

operations.title: Regulatory Alerts & Breach Notification Center (/alerts)
operations.description: Navigate to Deficiency Alerts view, inspect system-wide regulatory deficiency flags, and verify unread badge indicator.

operations.title: Acknowledge Scrutiny Alert Item
operations.description: Acknowledge a critical deficiency alert and verify immediate visual update to resolved state.

operations.title: Settings & Cryptographic Trust Verification (/settings)
operations.description: Navigate to Settings and inspect the Tamper-Evident SHA-256 Audit Chain section.

operations.title: Audit Chain Cryptographic Integrity Verification
operations.description: Click "Verify Chain Integrity" to execute cryptographic verification of the tamper-evident SHA-256 ledger.

operations.title: Global Application Shell Theme Toggle (Light Mode)
operations.description: Toggle application-wide theme to Light Mode and verify full UI re-styling (cards, typography, borders, charts).

operations.title: Global Application Shell Theme Toggle (Dark Mode)
operations.description: Toggle theme back to high-contrast Dark Mode for standard executive scrutiny operations.

operations.title: Tablet Viewport Verification (1024x768)
operations.description: Simulate high-resolution tablet device (iPad Landscape / 1024x768) and audit grid stacking and menu responsiveness.

operations.title: Mobile Viewport Verification (390x844 iPhone)
operations.description: Simulate modern smartphone device (390x844) and audit responsive executive summary, stat cards, and overflow behaviors.
